comment: Whole-room top view locates the task; close view shows the manipulable object, its support, and whatever else is within 1.60 m of that support -- the seat, the bed -- so the picture reads as a place rather than as an isolated slab. All walls retain full height; only the ceiling and outer facade are hidden. The bedroom bed and the counter-room jar are figure-only geometry substitutions recorded in each render provenance.

renamed.why: The room was labelled `kitchen` because its scene spec is `kitchen_fetch_jar`, but the delivered room contains an island, a stool, a cabinet and a plant, and no stove, sink or fridge -- the prompt never asked for any. A viewer told it is a kitchen looks for the appliances and finds none, which makes the label the defect rather than the render. `counter` is what is actually in frame: a counter island with a stool at it, and a jar to be fetched from the top. The scene id, the delivery and every hash are unchanged; only what the figure calls the row is.
